$comment: Seed for OWN_HOME/ratecards.json (02 §2.4.4; rates from 02 §6.2 and, for DeepSeek, its pricing page; TTLs from 01 §8.7). Decodes with @own/protocol Ratecard.File. Units: codex = credits per 1M tokens, API = USD per 1M tokens. A rate set to null is not billed (e.g. codex cache writes). An omitted rate is unknown: `out` falls back to the pinned template's cost.output and, when that is empty too, the estimator reports rate_unknown instead of using 0 (02 §2.4.4). inFromCatalog = input rate from the template cost; readMul/writeMul multiply the input rate; without read or readMul the cache read rate is the catalog's cost.cache.read. peak = UTC windows of peak prices (days 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday, from inclusive, to exclusive, never across midnight); outside them every rate is multiplied by offPeakMul, at the request time, for estimates and ledger costs, and a card with peak windows prices its ledger lines instead of the core catalog USD (02 §6.2, §7.5). A card without peak has flat rates. ttl.warmLowerSec = TTL_lo, ttl.coldUpperSec = TTL_hi (null = unknown -> policy.unknownTtlIdleMinutes). 'unverified' (ignored by the decoder) lists values that are assumptions or secondary sources. The Claude subscription slot has no card: it only shows limit % (02 §6.2, §8.6).
